usageProductPrice.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF635_UsageManagement/blob/v5.0.0/TMF635-Product_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductUsage/properties/usageProductPrice'. Price assigned to the product usage when product usage is rated. The price should be valued without applied taxes (dutyFreeAmount), that permits to avoid loss of precision. Better precision is reached by applying taxes on the total dutyFreeAmount of several Product Usage Price. Note that in this API the recurringChargePeriod attribute is not applicable.

product.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF635_UsageManagement/blob/v5.0.0/TMF635-Product_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductUsage/properties/product'. A Product reference. In TMF this is a ProductRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced Product entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Product:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

usageSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF635_UsageManagement/blob/v5.0.0/TMF635-Product_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ProductUsage/properties/usageSpecification'. ProductUsageSpecification reference. ProductUsageSpecification is a detailed description of a product usage event that are of interest to the business and can have charges applied to it. It is comprised of characteristics, which define all attributes known for a particular type of usage. In TMF this is a ProductUsageSpecificationRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced ProductUsageSpecification entity (urn:ngsi-ld:ProductUsageSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

allOf.description: An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

owner.description: Name of the external system that owns the entity.

externalIdentifierType.description: Type of the identification, typically would be the type of the entity within the external system
